list.name: network
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT network FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity ORDER BY network

panels.title: Hosting Capacity by Method (latest run)
panels.description: Latest comparable run (payload v2, status ok, bounded) per method and voltage framework. Compare rows only within the same framework and load_scale. Stochastic = F^-1(alpha) of the critical penetration, with a distribution-free CI.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method, criterion_framework) method, criterion_framework, load_scale, run_timestamp, total_pv_mw_comparable, total_pv_mw_p50, lambda_max, hc_alpha, hc_lambda_ci_low, hc_lambda_ci_high, binding_constraint, n_scenarios, git_commit FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable ORDER BY method, criterion_framework, run_timestamp DESC

panels.title: Total PV Hosting Capacity — Comparable Number (MW)
panels.description: deterministic/qsts: PV at the largest verified-feasible lambda. stochastic: F^-1(alpha) of the critical penetration (conservative). Only comparable rows are shown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method, criterion_framework) method || ' / ' || criterion_framework AS metric, total_pv_mw_comparable AS value FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable ORDER BY method, criterion_framework, run_timestamp DESC

panels.title: Binding Constraint (deterministic / QSTS)
panels.description: Which element (voltage, line, or transformer) limited hosting capacity first, per method. Non-convergence shows as 'power_flow_non_convergence' rather than a physical element.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method, criterion_framework) method, criterion_framework, lambda_max, lambda_fail, binding_constraint FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable AND method IN ('deterministic', 'qsts') ORDER BY method, criterion_framework, run_timestamp DESC
